caption: The drawing features a detailed pencil illustration of a cylindrical mug with a slightly flared top rim and a decorative handle on the left side. The mug is rendered in shades of grey with subtle shading to indicate volume and curvature. Below the mug, there is a vertical depiction of the handle from a top view, showing it as a simple, elongated oval shape. In the upper right corner of the composition, there is a small, simplified side elevation sketch of the entire mug including its handle. The drawing is executed on a light beige background and confined within a lightly outlined rectangular border. In the lower right corner, the signature "Amelia Tucio 1936" is neatly inscribed.
title: Silver Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
